'''Aine 15 (March 30)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[998 NE]] - [[Rand]] and his party, led by [[Moiraine]], arrive at [[Baerlon]].
*[[998 NE]] - Rand experiences his first encounter with [[Ba'alzamon]] in his dreams.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Siuan]] delivers [[Egwene]]'s orders that there is to be no attempt to rescue Egwene from the [[White Tower]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Beonin]] defects from the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] to the Tower and teaches [[Elaida]] how to [[traveling|travel]].
*[[1000 NE]] - Egwene divulges her plans to undermine Elaida.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Aran'gar]] spies on a rebel [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] meeting in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
